purpose: Make provider-backed artifact continuity a repository/workflow inheritance rule rather than a repeatedly rediscovered per-repository judgment.
trigger_conditions: entering or creating a repository/workflow that references provider-backed artifacts
a task reads, edits, reformats, exports, or creates a document/spreadsheet/presentation/file
a known artifact mapping or canonical cloud source is already available
an agent is about to return a downloadable/local artifact for work that has a provider-backed source
handoff or closeout would otherwise leave a provider-backed mutation unsynchronized
invariants: Known provider-backed source identity must be considered before creating a new local canonical artifact.
When an exact provider source is resolved and accessible, provider authority is checked before consuming or mutating a derivative.
When a provider write is authorized for edit/format work, the provider source is the completion target; a local-only derivative is not completion.
A local file generated from a provider-backed source is ephemeral by default. A persistent derivative requires explicit export intent.
When provider access or write authority is unavailable, safe local work may continue only with an explicit unresolved synchronization obligation and must not be reported as synchronized.
When a verified provider link is available, return it as the primary artifact reference.
Filename/title search is discovery only. Once exact source identity is known, normal execution uses the exact binding.
Current-runtime provider work stays in CURRENT_CHAT_RUNTIME when that runtime has the required provider access and authority.
Local executors consume sanitized semantic evidence and exact READY handoffs; they do not choose provider authority or invent locators.
A new repository inherits this semantic contract by version/reference; recopying the principle into each repository is migration debt.

future_inheritance.new_repository_rule: Repository/bootstrap tooling should expose artifact-continuity-preflight/v1 from root wayfinding or a pinned shared dependency before artifact-producing work begins.
future_inheritance.existing_repository_rule: Migrate representative existing consumers by archetype; do not require blanket handwritten duplication.
future_inheritance.capability_relationship: The preflight decides when artifact continuity applies. capabilities/artifact-sync owns synchronization mechanics once a binding is selected.

privacy.rule: Tracked preflight packets use semantic identities and sanitized state only; raw private provider locators remain in protected provider transport.

proof_ceiling: Deterministic artifact-authority routing from supplied evidence only; provider authentication, live source mutation, deployment, and production behavior remain separate proof.
